goal: Discover contrasting combat profiles and suspicious extremes, not a single fun optimum.
metricLimitation: Archive coverage measures exploration only. It is not a score for balance or enjoyment. All discarded candidates remain as evidence.
userPriority: Preserve ranges, directions and offense/recovery/intervention tradeoffs; no automatic product rebalance.
guard: Each full run must replay to exactly the saved final State; frozen playRules and source hashes recorded.
feasibilityNote: Researcher working bands, not user-approved acceptance criteria. Nonfeasible candidates remain visible; skilled zero-damage runs are flagged, not rejected.
selection: Within feasible candidates (fallback all explicitly flagged), offense minimizes win encounter time; resilience (damage prevention, not demonstrated recovery) minimizes deaths then damage taken; intervention maximizes paired tactician-over-autopilot win delta then paired win-time savings. Select distinct candidates with id tie-break. AI intervention is not manual control payoff.
refinement: After the grid, each selected profile proposes at most 2 new one-axis neighbors at half grid step, within initial bounds, for at most 6 serial packets. Re-select profiles using training only; freeze before validation.
followups: Selected candidates: same-seed loadout keep/legacy/adaptive/assault comparisons and tactician no-pull/no-row/no-defense ablations, after freezing selection. Diagnostic only; no retuning from validation.
limitations: AI issues commands to all allies directly; handoff/UI effort not modeled.
Same starting seed does not ensure aligned random events after trajectories diverge.
Duration of failed runs is censored and never reported as fast clear.
Observed break damage rates are confounded by target, skill and exposure.
Readability, jackpot excitement and actual human intervention value remain human judgments.
